## Problem and approach

Describe the problem, the chosen approach, and any user-visible behavior or
compatibility change. Link the prior issue for a larger change.

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request is one coherent change.
- [ ] Tests cover the behavior change, or the change is documentation-only.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and examples are updated.
- [ ] Generated run or campaign evidence is not included.
- [ ] This pull request contains no vulnerability details, secrets, or private data; security reports follow `SECURITY.md`.
